changes.title: Statue spacing
items: The challenge circle's statues stand further apart, so each young statue is in plain view instead of hidden behind its adult.

changes.title: Treehouse one room
items: The treehouse is one open home: Bedrooms 2 and 3 are open to walk into (their furniture still under dust sheets), and the canopy indoors opens in a circle round you.
The cauldron's smoke now spreads 10 m round the pot for about ten seconds, and anyone who walks into it takes the potion.

changes.title: Guest beach cache
items: Visiting a friend's island no longer rebuilds its beach for every game and music update.
